title: Concept surgery: the shapes of seven concept groups inside Qwen3-4B, and whether swapping one concept for another changes what the model does
written: 2026-10-16, before any run; follows exp115 (weekday circle real, but turning it didn't change answers; the full 6-d day component did)

numbers.task: What number comes after {X}? Answer with a word.

planets.items: Mercury Venus Earth Mars Jupiter Saturn
planets.task: Which planet comes after {X} in order from the Sun?

countries.items: France Japan Germany Italy Spain China Egypt Canada Russia

colours.items: red orange yellow green blue purple
colours.task: Name a fruit that is usually {X}.

animals.items: dog cat cow duck sheep lion pig horse

design.answer: chat template, no thinking, task + ' Answer with just one word.'; the answer is the first generated token (stripped, lowercased)
design.mapping: f(X) = the model's own baseline answer for X; items whose baseline answer collides with another item's are dropped (reported)
design.means: residual after each block at the X token in 6 neutral sentences ('I was thinking about{X} today.' etc.), averaged per item
design.shape: cycle sets: circular order of the top-2 PC angles (exp115 statistic); line sets: |Spearman| between PC1 coordinate and order; all sets: share of the item-mean variance in the top 2 PCs
design.swap: at the X token of the task prompt, at block b: add alpha * (mean_Y - mean_X) restricted to the top-D principal directions of the set's item means at b; D = 2 (the visible shadow) or all (n-1); alpha = 1 unless stated; blocks 2,4,6,8,10,12,16,20,24
design.success: the answer after the swap equals f(Y)
design.control: the same norm of change in a random direction (at block 8, D = all)

hypotheses.H1: At block 8 with the full component (D = all), the swap gives f(Y) for >= 50% of pairs in at least 5 of the 7 sets; the random control gives f(Y) for <= 5% of pairs overall.
hypotheses.H2: In every set, the 2-D swap (D = 2) succeeds less often than the full swap at block 8.
hypotheses.H3: In every set, the full swap succeeds less often at block 24 than at block 8.

decision_rule: Fixed sets, templates, blocks and thresholds; nothing re-tuned after results; failures reported.
